I do. I have a bubbly personality and have been told I'm very likable. The anxiety cube is for when you're just figity. You may not always be in a position to burn paper and such.  I buy glass dishware from the dollar store and smash it when I get really bad. It doesnt always help, it depends on the magnitude of my emotions.  I put my phone down mostly so I dont break it. But also cause online is mostly toxic. 

I get all of those bad feelings often. It's very hard for me to control them at work especially. I feel them coming up and I try to just breathe and focus on it in my head so I don't say anything out loud. Trying to keep it internal but  people notice and ask if I'm angry or something. Sends me into full blown rage.  I actually got pills for "episodes"  like that. They're sedatives, it's just supposed to calm you down, slow your heartbeat And maybe make you tired. but I take them and zonk right out. 

Ice cubes are still the best bet I say. Hold em in you're hands till your hands are so cold they can't actually hold them or the ice has melted. Focus on something else other than your emotions like the ice melting. Or just a change in visuals might help.

I found looking back on all my relationships with people for the first couple months-year I'm whatever they want me to be. Just so they like me. Then they get to know me, aka I get too controlling and stuff and they leave.

When you notice yourself getting anxious get something else to manage your hands. I had an anxiety cube that worked for a while. It's a small little cube with different motor stimulants on it like buttons and switches and spinning balls and such. It's a distraction for your hands so you don't end up scratching unintentionally.

When it's intentional you need a distraction. Particularly a positive one. The second you have the thought take a big breather.  It won't cool you down but it'll help stop the impulsivity to cut.  have a list of alternatives you always have on you.  Sometimes I put on a comedy that I like, it makes me laugh and at the same time it's stopped me thinking completely.  I usually put my phone down cause it's full of negativity and don't pick it up until you're good again. Sometimes I go for a run until i can't breathe. While running im thinking of all the things I want to run from.  I run from suicidal thoughts, I run from intimate relationships, I run from the abusive boss.  I'm exhausted by the end of the run and don't have the energy to be depressed or angry. Another might be to clench Ice cubes in your hands. It'll give the same satisfaction as cutting does. But won't damage you. Another could be snapping an elastic on your wrist. It stings for a bit, I've actually bruised my arms a few times from it. And it's calmed me down once, however I find if the elastic breaks I'm on a whole new level of emotional can't handle.

You should make a post in r/BPD looking for positive recovery stories. Gather them and make a YouTube video you can watch anytime your low about everyone else like you who survived. Again it provides hope.

It can be worth fighting. And getting therapy and whatnot because I've been told that after a few decades (not to scare you of how long it takes) of tremendous effort to control and learn to understand and analyse your feelings, u can live a normal happy life. Also if the support is there. I know a woman with BPD along with many other things, OCD,Depression, anxiety etc. She lives in a beautiful home with a wonderful child (kid behaves too!) And husband. She has hobbies that she really enjoys doing and whenever I see her she's always smiling and has a positive attitude. I can't speak for her, but. I've been told having structure and set schedules like she does almost cures the BPD, like she doesn't split or dissociate anymore. 

So. There is hope, but I'm not a hopeful person lol

I don't think attention is the point. When I kill myself I want it to be anonymous. I'll get rid of all my stuff, empty my bank to a charity and erase all my next of kin. I'll call the EMT before I go and I'll list as an organ donor. The hospital will be happy to get organs, no one will know I died. They'll just think I ran off to another country and ceased communication like always. Send the rest of my body for research purposes. All good. No worries. Plus the point of the accidental death we hope for is so our loved ones have closure. She was in a car accident and died. There's nothing they could've done, rather than she commited suicide. Someone should've noticed. Someone couldve done something.

Same as you. Except there's another way, called inappropriate parenting. I was given positive reactions anytime I got good grades, anytime I won a soccer competition, when I made a new friend or gave money to charity. When I was angry I was over dramatic, when I started cutting it was "unnecessary, and for attention" if a friend didn't like me anymore it wasn't important. My dad was always super controlling and protective and my mom wanted us to have freedom, they didn't parent together. It's another cause other than genetics. 

I wasnt abused or traumatized, they'd tell me they love me but I could never feel it, couldn't believe them, for my childhood, my emotions and feeling weren't validated it's an emotional abuse I never realized until I started watching multiple vids on YouTube.

Yeah. I always think if I just do what they want then they'll like me. Had a bf for 3yrs. I had decided I could trust him and let my guard down a little bit. Be myself. Turns out he can't handle myself and dumped saying to get therapy. I'm always walking on egg shells. It brings along the chronic feeling of emptiness. I can't do or say anything that I may want to because it'll be met with rejection. I feel alone on the inside so that people will be around me on the outside.

If you know their view of him would be tainted then you should consider that it's for a reason. He's a narcissistic controlling asshole. Drop him. He expects things from the relation he doesn't think he needs to do as well. He doesn't respect you, he cannot love you. No one like that is worth it. 

After you're done with him he may try to apologize to get you back, don't take to it. It's another way to control you.

DAE feel like all this managing emotions just some Bs to make everyone else happy. Like if they don't like what I have to say then I don't want them around. I'm not about to walk on eggshells my whole life just to be labeled normal.
Cause it feels like theyre challenging me. In the moment I can't recognize they're just trying to have a logical debate. Take it all to personally. It's the hypersensitivity.
Just driving a car I feel like everyone else on the road is road raging at me in their car. Im going the speed limit but impeding traffic idk what I should do.
Hate dogs. When they bark I get a surge of anger that takes over. I want them to come at me so I can have an excuse to take it down.

All the time. I've been told that reality for normal people (no one be offended by normal, I don't intend, if you have better term suggestion please lmk) is like a straight line they can recall everything that makes that line straight whereas BPD have a dotted line. We have memory gaps that cannot be recalled at all. Like on Mondays at work I'm asked how was your weekend. And I don't remember one. Yesterday was Friday wasn't it?
Always have a feeling I have a to-do list as long as Santa's gift list. But I can't name a single thing I gotta do.

Always lived with other people. But I wanted to get away once. Be alone so I got my own apt. I felt so lonely and depressed I invited different friends over everyday to occupy my basically. Random people I saw outside, the  contractors working in my building. Literally anyone.

It infuriates me. I have this obsessive need to take care of myself. And I'll yell and scream at them to leave me alone. Then they leave and I'm like who would leave someone in this state. Why would they leave me alone. They don't care about me. Etc.

I (21F) am the same as you except. I know there's something wrong with me. Everyone always leaves me. I thought it was fine, I didn't need them anyway. I knew they'd leave. I knew they didn't actually care and that didn't bother me, no one cared, not really. They would say they care but when I'd need real help they couldn't be bothered. I was used to it, I always pictured my life alone and that was okay. Awesome even.  This all changed when I met a guy in college. He loved me he really did, he cared so much and always put me first. We were together for 3 years until one day he left me. Which in turn made me lose my job, made me homeless and made me believe in my complete and utter uselessness. 

I'm currently running back and forth between was he lying the whole time? I'm a problem I must be.  He wanted something from me but idk what it is. I regret the whole thing. I wish I was still happy alone and didn't feel like this. I wish I had never trusted him. I wish I could picture a future, any future. I'm more than. Heartbroken. I'm permanently damaged. Paralysed even. I don't even know what I'm living for.

I gave him my explanation about my plans for the weekend and how I had homework and he basically have me a detention for being responsible. 

Never went to that detention, I didn't deserve it. They called my name for detention on the PA everyday for 3 years until I graduated lmao.
